Velmora Bridge Visitor Centre

The visitor centre stands at the north end of the Velmora Bridge, on the bank of the river Osk.

It opened in 1986, on the bridge's 75th anniversary.

Opening hours

  • April to October: 09:00–18:00
  • November to March: 10:00–16:00

Entry is free.
Guided walks across the arch cost 6 crowns.
